🎟️ TOUR NEWS: TX2 announce first European headline tour for 2027

TX2 have announced their first European headline run, tied to their debut album End of Us. Five German dates are confirmed for the tour: Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, Frankfurt and Cologne.
